headline: TEX @ MIA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TEX 4.14 at MIA 4.73, with a projected total of 8.87. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIA: TEX moved +0.21 runs while MIA moved +0.53, changing the projected margin by -0.32 runs. The projected total climbed +0.74, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -10.0%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Kumar Rocker has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Wyatt Langford, Otto Lopez, Jake Burger, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Joc Pederson, Justin Foscue because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
